Vim-inspired keyboard shortcuts for task navigation, creation, and status changes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `j`/`k` for list navigation
- [ ] `c` to create task, `e` to edit
- [ ] `1`-`5` to set priority
- [ ] `?` to show shortcut cheat sheet
